description: Fixed Broadband Deployment Data: Dec, 2018 Status V1 is a dataset listed in Federal Communications Commission open data portal (opendata.fcc.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a national body, published or maintained by Federal Communications Commission. The data collected to create this dataset was in place through data as of June, 2021. Coverage: United States. The table has 17 columns. The portal shows 2019-12-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-fcc-gov-portal.
